themes.name: AI compute: NVIDIA's supply chain
themes.what: On Nov 2 LITE fell 18.6% to 684.40 and MRVL 12.7% to 171.41 (Massive). At 4.5 Marvell shares per Lumentum share, LITE now trades about 11.3% under the offer, and Lumentum's filing says closing is expected in the first half of 2028 (SEC 8-K). Separately, Apple guided its gross margin down to about 45.5% this quarter from 47.9% because of memory chip costs (Motley Fool, Nov 3), more proof that memory is the scarce part of the AI build.
themes.for_you: No action. MRVL is Wait, LITE is buyout pending, AAPL is Wait. MU is left out of both lists: Apple's cost is Micron's price gain, but MU fell 5.8% on Nov 2 with the tech selloff and has no verdict.

innovations.name: Industrials
innovations.what: Rechecked on the daily rotation. Symbotic has not set its fiscal Q4 date (a third party site lists Nov 23, unconfirmed); it guided Q4 revenue to $760 to $780 million. Stratasys has not announced the close of its $42.5 million Markforged purchase, and PTC has not set the shareholder vote on Schneider's $205 a share cash offer. No stage changes: none of the four innovations has new cost, approval or revenue data since Oct 26.
innovations.for_you: No action. None is on a buy list or a setup. Watch Symbotic's report in late November for backlog, the best gauge of warehouse robot demand.

countries.name: Gulf (Saudi Arabia, UAE, Qatar, Iran risk)
countries.what: The Wall Street Journal reported a limited US strike on Iran's Qeshm Island late Nov 2, home to a missile site, a naval base and a desalination plant; Iranian state media reported five explosions (France 24, CNBC). Brent had settled at $104.77, down 7.6%, on peace talk hopes and rose to about $105.77 on Nov 3 (NBC, CNBC). Trump says a deal could happen; Qatari mediators went to Tehran Nov 2 (CBS, Al Jazeera).
countries.for_you: Swing: XOM touched its 183.99 target only at the Nov 2 open and closed at 179.67; keep stops at least at the entries. Producers and tankers are left out of both lists today: talks push oil down, strikes push it up, and both are happening at once.
